newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Institutions take 10.4 pct Taiwan stock turnover.
newsitem.headline: Institutions take 10.4 pct Taiwan stock turnover.

text.p: Institutional investors accounted for 10.4 percent of Taiwan's stock market turnover in the first nine months of 1996, the first time the ratio has eclipsed 10 percent, government statistics said on Wednesday.
In the first nine months, stock market turnover reached T$9.172 trillion, up 12.6 percent from the same 1995 period, the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics said in a statement.

Of the nine-month total, institutional investors represented 10.4 percent, including local institutions with 8.3 percent and foreign institutions 2.1 percent, up a year-on-year 1.6 and 0.8 percentage points, respectively, it said.
The increase in institutional investment would help the healthy development of the domestic stock market, it said.
Analysts say institutional investors tend to be less speculative than individual investors.
